final_claim: For an annealed iid site environment globally refreshed after each step with probability p, the speed and variance at δ=1−p have expansions u=d−dwδ²/2+O(δ⁴), V=1−d²+3d²wδ²−w²δ³/2+O(δ⁴), uniformly in the site law; the zero-drift local variance sign reverses, with sharp weak-drift crossover, and the fair deterministic-arrow case has exact V(p)=p(3−p)²/((2−p)(1+p)²).
limitations: Global monotonicity is only the fair deterministic-arrow benchmark; generic result local near p=1; crossover equality line remains undecided.
